objective: Test whether fitting the action-dependent 95pct risk residual conditional on the saved state-only Q2 baseline improves absolute segment-risk pinball on independent physical actions.
scope: Different supervised target/parameterization from closed joint Q2 absolute-risk head; saved Q2 weights and labels remain frozen. This is reused 2018-2020 optimization history, not temporal OOS or SOXX evidence.
clock_and_population: 2018-2020 matured source labels only. Fit source: same day/anchor/action weights and known-mask as closed Q2 risk head, excluding held_physical_independent. Evaluate saved independent physical held actions on all 2019-2020 native days; preserve unknown day positions. No 2021plus outcome read.
training_target: r_i = actual absolute segment max drawdown_i minus saved Q2 prediction at u=0 before received-DD clipping. For fixed z, quantile translation makes q95(r_i|z,u)+Q2_0(z) a q95 absolute-risk estimate. Do not fit on realized HOLD risk or compare quantile differences with realized means.
model: One cvxpy CLARABEL tau0.95 pinball fit of r_i on (c0+C standardized_z) dot physical u plus 0.5 u' H u, H PSD, no intercept or state-only term, Q2 saved weighted state scaler, ridge lambda1 on c0,C,H, same day/anchor/action weights, OPTIMAL only. This retains zero action correction at u=0.
inference: predicted absolute risk=max(saved Q2 raw(z,0)+fitted action correction(z,u), genuinely received close drawdown). Baseline=max(saved Q2 raw(z,0), received drawdown). Closed Q2 comparator=its saved full action prediction with same floor.

fixed_information_gates.support: at least100 distinct joint-known held-action days in each of2019 and2020
fixed_information_gates.annual: positive dayweighted pinball improvement vs both baseline and closed Q2 separately in each year
fixed_information_gates.uncertainty: 20-native-day circular blocks,10000 resamples,seed20261112, one-sided alpha0.0125 for each of two pooled contrasts; both lower bounds positive
fixed_information_gates.transmission: On saved held physical actions grouped by same day/anchor, candidate minimum-risk action (fixed action_id lexicographic tie rule within1e-10) or the set with predicted absolute risk<=0.30 differs from closed Q2 on at least20 distinct native days in each year. No actor is created by this diagnostic.

after_gate: If all information gates pass, separately freeze a continuous three-asset actor and exact f696+b472 matched own-state 0/2/5bp Qlib account; no direct account or promotion from this card. If a fixed gate fails, close this model without lambda/tau/action-grid/year rescue.
